# Endpoints, statuses and enums

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-skill.py from protocol/data/*.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

## Endpoints

| SDK method | HTTP | Signed | Encrypted body |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CreatePayment` | `POST /api/v1/payments` | yes | yes |
| `QueryPaymentByOrderNo` | `GET /api/v1/payments?orderNo=...` | yes | - |
| `QueryPaymentByMerchantOrderNo` | `GET /api/v1/payments?merchantOrderNo=...` | yes | - |
| `CreatePayout` | `POST /api/v1/payouts` | yes | yes |
| `QueryPayoutByOrderNo` | `GET /api/v1/payouts?orderNo=...` | yes | - |
| `QueryPayoutByMerchantOrderNo` | `GET /api/v1/payouts?merchantOrderNo=...` | yes | - |
| `GetBalance` | `GET /api/v1/balances?currency=...` | yes | - |
| `GetPayoutReceipt` | `GET /api/v1/payouts/{orderNo}/receipt` | yes | - |
| `GetUSDRate` | `GET /api/v1/usd-rates?currency=...&payMethod=...` | yes | - |
| `GetPaymentCheckout` | `GET /api/v1/payment/checkout?orderNo=...` | - | - |
| `SubmitPaymentTradeNo` | `POST /api/v1/payment/submitTradeNo` | - | - |
| `AddPaymentExtraInfo` | `POST /api/v1/payment/addExtraInfo` | - | - |

The last three form the **checkout group**: your hosted checkout page cannot hold the
merchant private key, so this group is neither signed nor encrypted and exchanges plain
JSON. Their fields do not mean the same thing:

| Endpoint | `status` | `orderStatus` |
|---|---|---|
| `GetPaymentCheckout` (GET) | the public order status string mapped from the raw state (`CREATED` / `PENDING` / ...) | the raw numeric order state the platform stores |
| `SubmitPaymentTradeNo` (POST) | acceptance of this call: `1` accepted, `0` refused, `message` says why | the order's public status **after** the call, as a string |
| `AddPaymentExtraInfo` (POST) | acceptance of this call: `1` accepted, `0` refused, `message` says why | the order's public status after the call, as a string; `paymentUrl` is set once the order was placed upstream |

For the two POSTs, `status` is the outcome of the call and `orderStatus` describes the
order; neither is the HTTP code. See "Key rules" in SKILL.md.

## Order statuses

`PENDING` / `PROCESSING` / `SUCCEEDED` / `FAILED` / `EXPIRED` / `CANCELED`

Only `SUCCEEDED` / `FAILED` / `EXPIRED` / `CANCELED` are final; everything else means the
order is still processing. Do not treat a non-final status as failure.

## Currencies

`BRL` / `ARS` / `MXN` / `COP` / `CLP` / `PEN` / `TRY` / `USD` / `BDT` / `IDR` / `PHP` / `PKR` / `INR`

## Countries

`BR` / `AR` / `MX` / `CO` / `CL` / `PE` / `TR` / `US` / `BD` / `ID` / `PH` / `PK` / `IN`

An order can only be created in these currencies; the gateway refuses any other. The
country is derived from the currency and returned on the order; it is not checked on
the way in. `GetBalance` and `GetUSDRate` accept any currency and are not limited to
this list.
